reasoning: A hybrid strategy combines autonomous reasoning to identify semantically irrelevant features with external XAI tools to quantify their attribution, improving detection of spurious correlations. This approach leverages domain knowledge to ground the analysis and uses rigorous feature attribution methods to validate and measure the influence of potentially irrelevant features on the wrong prediction.

autonomous_tasks.query: Why might 'occupation=Farming-fishing' or 'workclass=Self-emp-inc' be semantically irrelevant to income class <=50K in this context?
autonomous_tasks.expected_output: A list of features that are semantically disconnected from income <=50K despite being present in the input

autonomous_tasks.query: Compare the semantic relevance of each input feature to the true label (<=50K) and evaluate whether the model's high attribution to any feature contradicts its real-world significance.
autonomous_tasks.expected_output: A ranked list of features with semantic relevance scores and a flag indicating spuriousness

tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides robust, interpretable feature importance based on game theory, helping identify which features drive the model toward predicting >50K despite the true label being <=50K. LIME offers local interpretability to validate model behavior in this specific instance. Integrated Gradients offer a consistent gradient-based attribution baseline that reveals how smoothly the model transitions from zero to prediction. Sensitivity analysis evaluates the impact of removing each feature, detecting whether any feature inflates the prediction without real-world correlation.
